records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Ines,

Welcome to Wrenfield. There's no wrong way to start -- create a project, add a few tasks, invite people, and adjust as you figure out what works for your team.

Reply here if you need a hand.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

draft.subject: A hand with your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Ines,

Following up on my last note — no pressure either way. If it's useful, I'm happy to help you get your first project set up in Wrenfield. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so it's usually the easiest place to start; the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. When you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? Reply with a couple of times and I'll work around you.

Best,
Chidi
